items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: Well, after that he showed me the stretches, tell me what it is... So I can go home and practice that on that old guitar I got home.

ctx.x: Did you get any help at all from any other guitar players that helped you?

Well I tell you, I was, I wasn't stopped. But I was only told how to do it while all the music stand with them. Yeah. And I was taking, asking them what do you call that, before I started playing guitar. And, because I wasn't playing a guitar when I was with my brother. I was, when Freddie had a violin I was just only hitting on it. But I wanted to learn to see what I was doing. Yeah. I wanted to, just like a fellow reading the paper. If he don't read it, he didn't, just looking at it, he can't get nothing out of…
Oh yes. I never knew him, I've heard of him.
